title: Blinding, CLOE and covariance
author: Cail Daley
description: Slides for the Paris CMBX SWG meeting: how the Euclid groups blind DR1 and what CMBX has to decide, the CLOE versus dr1_cmbx likelihood comparison on TR1 chains, and what CMBX needs for its covariance.

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: Title and index of the three parts.

sections.title: Covariance needs
sections.outline: What CMBX uses now, which covariance blocks it needs from whom, public inputs for SPT-like mocks, and questions for the covariance effort.

sections.title: Blinding
sections.outline: What the other Euclid groups are doing, how CMBX chooses its blind, and how to compare with other groups while blinded.

sections.title: CLOE vs dr1_cmbx
sections.outline: The same TR1 chains with CLOE and with the dr1_cmbx exact likelihood: posteriors, bias against the mock truth, cost. Production now samples CLOE directly through a JAX port.
